sources.title: Maniere de se récréer avec le jeu de cartes nommées Tarots
sources.curation_note: Primary divinatory and occult Tarot text with a source-declared public-domain download.
sources.provenance_note: Acquire exact Wellcome-served PDF bytes; do not normalize its card claims before EDCM analysis.

sources.title: The Tarot, in the form of leaves of the book of Thoth placed in the temple of Fire at Memphis, Egypt
sources.curation_note: Primary visual arrangement witness for Etteilla's Book-of-Thoth Tarot construction.
sources.provenance_note: Preserve the source's Egyptian framing as an asserted historical object, not as verified Tarot origin.

sources.title: Tablette catégorique des significations du Livre de Thot
sources.curation_note: Primary manuscript witness for card significations and cartomantic interpretation.
sources.provenance_note: Locator retained until the exact downloadable object URL is pinned in a later manifest revision.

sources.title: Cartes à jouer: Tarots de tous types
sources.curation_note: Institutional collection surface exposing more than 200 Tarot sets and multiple historical/divinatory families.
sources.provenance_note: Resolve each child object and its rights separately; collection membership does not grant bulk-download authority.

sources.title: Visconti di Modrone tarocchi deck
sources.authority: Yale University Library / Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
sources.curation_note: Early surviving Tarot witness with structural variation including additional court roles and virtues.
sources.provenance_note: Preserve item-level digital identities and Yale rights metadata when acquiring card images.

sources.title: Deck of Tarot de Marseille by Jean-Pierre Payen
sources.authority: Yale University Library / Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library
sources.curation_note: Historical Marseille-family deck witness from a major playing-card collection.
sources.provenance_note: Resolve item-level files and rights before byte acquisition.

sources.title: Sola Busca Tarot
sources.curation_note: Complete early Italian deck and crucial illustrated-pip witness.
sources.provenance_note: Institutional description is admitted now; image acquisition waits on exact object and reuse terms.

sources.title: Tarot de Jean Noblet
sources.curation_note: Early witness for the later-named Tarot de Marseille graphic family.
sources.provenance_note: Keep retrospective family naming attached to the source rather than treating it as original self-identification.

sources.title: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot
sources.authority: Wikimedia Commons / Wikisource scan of Arthur Edward Waite with Pamela Colman Smith illustrations
sources.curation_note: Primary RWS-era text linking 78 plates, descriptions, divinatory meanings, reversals, and spread procedure.
sources.provenance_note: Public-domain status is source-declared; direct upload identity remains to be pinned before automated retrieval.

sources.title: Monde primitif, eighth livraison, including Du Jeu des Tarots
sources.authority: Wikimedia Commons scan of Antoine Court de Gébelin
sources.curation_note: Primary eighteenth-century occult reinterpretation and Egyptian-origin claim witness.
sources.provenance_note: Admit the claim as Court de Gébelin's assertion; historical validation remains independent evidence.

sources.title: The Tarot of the Bohemians
sources.curation_note: Major occult-system witness retained as metadata despite source-declared copyright restriction.
sources.provenance_note: Do not automatically download or redistribute this Wellcome object.

sources.title: Règlement officiel du Tarot en donnes libres
sources.source_date: current rules surface at corpus freeze
sources.curation_note: Living French Tarot game-rule witness for deck use, ranking, scoring, bidding, and play relations.
sources.provenance_note: Game rules are evidence of one living Tarot practice, not a universal Tarot schema.

sources.title: Before Fortune-Telling: The History and Structure of Tarot Cards
sources.curation_note: Institutional synthesis connecting early material witnesses, game structure, and later fortune-telling history.
sources.provenance_note: Secondary interpretation; preserve source wording and object citations separately from primary artifacts.

sources.title: Master of the E-Series Tarocchi: Poetry (Poesia XXVII)
sources.curation_note: Near-neighbor negative control: a historically named Tarocchi series that the museum explicitly says is not a true Tarot deck.
sources.provenance_note: Retain as boundary evidence without silently including it as a Tarot deck.

sources.title: Tarot! Renaissance Symbols, Modern Visions
sources.curation_note: Contemporary institutional witness spanning Renaissance Tarot and twentieth/twenty-first-century artistic afterlives.
sources.provenance_note: Use as curated interpretive evidence; child-object rights remain independent.

sources.title: A Cultural History of Tarot: From Entertainment to Esotericism
sources.curation_note: Scholarly cultural-history synthesis covering Tarot's transition from game to esoteric and modern uses.
sources.provenance_note: Bibliographic/metadata evidence only unless licensed full text is supplied separately.

sources.title: Paper tools for broken hearts: fortune-telling with cards in France, c. 1803-1937
sources.authority: Oxford Academic / French History / William G. Pooley
sources.curation_note: Scholarly evidence for actual card-divination practice beyond occultist theory and Tarot-only narratives.
sources.provenance_note: Retain as secondary scholarship; no full-text redistribution is implied.
